capabilities: Rank and compare notes across frontmatter, file metadata, and formula properties
Create weighted composite score columns with drag-and-drop weights and live recalculation
Filter, group, and aggregate notes using histogram sliders, checkboxes, and box plots
Persist column layouts, weights, and filters into .base view configurations
Embed interactive read-only LineUp views in notes via Bases embed syntax
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.10+ for the native Bases engine. The manifest carries the warning 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.' Documented limitations: embedded views in notes only persist changes for the session, Canvas cards need at least 480px height, and multi-value tag lists filter poorly compared to scalar properties.
intentEvidence: Integrates directly into Obsidian Bases (type: lineup) as a native view.
problem: Obsidian Bases tables only offer single-column sorting and static query filters, so comparing notes across several weighted properties is hard to do visually.

relations.evidence: This plugin is built on the LineUp.js library by the Caleydo team.

summary: Interactive multi-attribute ranking view for Obsidian Bases, with weighted composite columns, visual filters, and grouping charts, built on LineUp.js.
